description.value: Pho Quynh Express is a Vietnamese noodle house in downtown Vancouver offering a broad menu of phở, vermicelli bowls, rice dishes, and appetizers including Vietnamese and vegetarian options. It is one of three Vancouver locations in the Pho Quynh Express chain, making it a predictable and familiar stop for cyclists passing through the city core. Online ordering with pickup is available, allowing cyclists to call ahead and minimize wait time.
